Birmingham, Alabama }} '''Eric Bledsoe''' (born October 23, 1990 in [[Birmingham, Alabama]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] [[point guard]] who most recently played for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|University of Kentucky Wildcats]].[http://www.ukathletics.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/bledsoe_eric00.html Eric Bledsoe profile] UK Athletics ==College Basketball== His academic eligibility during his college basketball career at Kentucky is currently under investigation by the [[NCAA]].[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/news/story?id=5231161] ==Professional basketball== On April 7, 2010, Bledsoe announced that he would forgo his final three seasons of collegiate eligibility and enter the [[2010 NBA Draft]].{{cite news|url=http://www.freep.com/article/20100408/SPORTS08/4080402/1049/Sports/Kentucky-frosh-to-try-for-NBA |title=Kentucky frosh to try for NBA|date=April 7, 2010 |publisher=freep.com}} Bledsoe, who is touted for his quickness, ball handling ability, and most recently his ability to hit the long ball, is expected to be a mid-first round pick in the upcoming NBA Draft.[http://www.spoonhoops.com/2010-Mock-Draft.php] spoonhoops.com ==External links== *[http://www.ukathletics.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/011210aac.html Bledsoe's Career Night Propels Kentucky Over Florida] ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bledsoe, Eric}} [[Category:1990 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Alabama]] [[Category:Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Birmingham, Alabama]] [[Category:Point guards]] {{1990s-US-basketball-bio-stub}}
